remarks:
Once a multifamily home, this spacious property has been completely transformed into an impressive 6-bedroom single-family residence, offering exceptional flexibility for today’s lifestyle. Step inside to a welcoming front parlour, followed by a comfortable living room/dining room combination perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The first floor offers two bedrooms, a full bath, convenient first-floor laundry, and a large rear entry with plenty of space to create the perfect mudroom.

Upstairs you’ll find four additional bedrooms, a second full bath, plus an oversized bonus room ideal for a family room, fitness area, playroom, media room, or whatever best fits your needs. Don’t need six bedrooms? The possibilities are endless—create a home office, craft room, dressing room, guest suite, study, or additional recreational space.

This home has undergone an extensive top-to-bottom renovation, including a new roof, windows, flooring, light fixtures, electrical wiring and panel box, hot water tank, forced-air furnace, insulation, plumbing, beautifully updated bathrooms, and new kitchen cabinetry. Fresh, updated, and ready for its next owner to simply move in and enjoy.

And two features that are always a welcome bonus in the city—a private driveway AND garage! With generous square footage, a flexible floor plan, major mechanical and cosmetic improvements already completed, and room for everyone, this is one you’ll want to see in person. Square footage, room count, and style of residence verified by licensed appraiser.
